questions.prompt: Under priority scheduling, which packet is sent next?
options: The oldest packet in any queue
One packet from each class in turn
A packet from the highest-priority queue that has packets waiting

questions.prompt: Under strict priority scheduling, a low-priority queue that never gets served is said to ______. (one word)
Round robin sends one packet per class per cycle, and skips classes whose queues are empty.
What does weighted fair queueing add to round robin?
options: Weights, giving each class a minimum share of bandwidth

questions.prompt: A 100 Mbps link uses WFQ with weights 4 and 1. What bandwidth, in Mbps, is guaranteed to the weight-4 class?
Under WFQ, if one class has nothing to send, its share of the link sits unused.
Which header field could a router use to sort packets into classes?
options: Any header field, such as type of service, protocol, or port
